events.name: St. Louis Blues at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Paval Zacha scored twice, Joonas Korpisalo made 37 saves and the Boston Bruins beat the St. Louis Blues 5-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zacha scores twice, Korpisalo makes 37 saves in Bruins' 5-2 win over Blues

events.name: New York Rangers at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Artemi Panarin reached 900 NHL points with a goal and an assist and the New York Rangers won for the league-leading 12th time on the road, beating the Ottawa Senators 4-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panarin reaches 900 NHL points, Rangers beat Senators 4-2 for NHL-best 12th road victory

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Evgeni Malkin scored his second goal of the game with 2:43 left and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-3 on Thursday night for their fourth victory in five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Malkin breaks late tie with 2nd goal of game, Penguins beat Lightning 4-3

headlines.description: — Steven Stamkos scored with 57 seconds left in overtime, and the Nashville Predators beat the Florida Panthers 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steven Stamkos wins it in OT, Predators beat reeling Panthers 2-1

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Mathew Barzal had a goal and two assists, and the New York Islanders defeated the NHL-leading Colorado Avalanche 6-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barzal’s goal, 2 assists help Islanders beat Avalanche 6-3

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Joseph Woll made 22 saves, Bobby McMann scored twice and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Carolina Hurricanes 5-1 on Thursday night to complete a six-game trip with their third straight victory and fourth in five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maple Leafs beat Hurricanes 5-1 to wrap up 6-game trip with 3rd straight victory

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Adam Fantilli tied it with 1:31 left in the regulation with his second goal of the game, Kirill Marchenko had the shootout winner and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Detroit Red Wings 6-5 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fantilli scores twice, Marchenko has shootout winner to lift Blue Jackets past Red Wings, 6-5

headlines.description: — Dustin Wolf made 26 saves, Jonathan Huberdeau ended a scoring drought and the Calgary Flames beat the surging Minnesota Wild 4-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dustin Wolf makes 26 saves, Flames slow surging Wild with 4-1 victory

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had his 13th career hat trick to tie Mark Messier for fourth in Oilers history and added an assist in Edmonton's 9-4 romp over the Seattle Kraken on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor McDavid has hat trick, 4 points in the Oilers' 9-4 romp over the Kraken

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Connor Bedard scored for the third straight games, Spencer Knight made 26 saves and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Los Angeles Kings 2-1 on Thursday night to open a two-game set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Bedard scores for 3rd straight game, Blackhawks hold off Kings 2-1
